description: This source file implements a class and functions for simplifying loop conditions in an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) as part of a shader compiler or translator. It transforms loop conditions into regular statements to facilitate further code transformations.

classes.name: SimplifyLoopConditionsTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses an AST to identify and transform loop conditions for simplification.

methods.name: SimplifyLoopConditionsTraverser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the traverser with a mask for conditions to simplify and a symbol table.

methods.name: traverseLoop
methods.description: Traverses a loop node, detects if its condition or expression can be simplified, and performs the transformation.
